crossRefs.note: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and…
But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this…
There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
Now therefore see the king whom you have chosen, and whom you have asked for. Behold, Yahweh has set a king over you.
Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whom they asked of him.
But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
Then he released to them Barabbas, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.
Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.
translations.bsb: As they had requested, he released the one imprisoned for insurrection and murder, and he handed Jesus over to their will.
translations.kjv: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
translations.asv: And he released him that for insurrection and murder had been cast into prison, whom they asked for; but Jesus he delivered up to their will.
